name: Predicción Intra-Cuadro
description: Analiza patrones de predicción intra-cuadro para detectar manipulación de video
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Intra-frame Prediction Analysis
mechanism:
This method analyzes H.264/H.265 intra-prediction patterns for video forensic detection:

1. **Intra - Prediction Mode Extracción**: For I-frames and intra-blocks in P/B-frames, the selected intra-prediction modes are extracted from the bitstream (9 modes in H.264, 35+ in H.265: DC, planar, and angular predictions). These mode decisions are influenced by local image content.

2. **Mode Distribución Análisis**: The statistical distribution of intra-prediction modes across the frame is analyzed. Natural video produces characteristic mode distributions — predominantly DC/planar in smooth regions, angular modes following edge orientations. Manipulated or AI-generated content may show anomalous mode distributions inconsistent with the visual content.

3. **Mode - Content Consistencia**: The selected mode should match the actual image content direction. At a horizontal edge, a horizontal prediction mode should be selected. The method checks mode-content alignment — content inserted from a different encoding may show suboptimal mode selections (modes chosen for the original content, not the replaced content).

4. **Prediction Residual Análisis**: The intra-prediction residual (actual − predicted) encodes what the prediction couldn't capture. Residual statistics differ between original content (well-predicted, small residuals) and replaced content (poorly predicted by modes chosen for different content, larger residuals). The method detects anomalous residual distributions.

5. **Re - Encoding Signature Detección**: Double-encoded video (original + manipulation + re-encoding) shows characteristic intra-prediction artifacts: the second encoder's mode decisions partially align with the first encoder's block structure, creating detectable periodicity in prediction residuals.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
